show.description: When billionaire Adarsh Sharma returns to India, a sudden accident leaves his parents critically injured. Stripped of proof of identity, he is ridiculed and denied access to his own wealth. As time runs out, desperation turns into rebellion, forcing him into a daring heist of his own bank. Amid greed, ego, and injustice, the story unfolds as a gripping tale of survival, identity, and moral reckoning. Watch Now.
